note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse, or at its "from" words inside the verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. God is not pictured, Job and his friends are not portrayed as biblical people but shown through ordinary people of today, and nothing violent is shown.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21 after the sentence-by-sentence pictures did not connect: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures. What he said went wrong before: he could not tell why some pictures were there, could not connect them to the meaning, and some were too abstract.

sections.meaning: Job's anguish, if it could be weighed, would be heavier than all the sand of the seas; he cries out because he truly suffers, as no animal cries out while it has its food, and what he is given to swallow sickens him.
ideas: A grey-haired man sits on one pan of a giant old balance scale on a wide beach; his side has sunk to the sand while the other pan, heaped with a mountain of sand, is lifted high
A brass balance scale on a beach: one small dark stone in one pan outweighs a great heap of sand in the other
A man sits hunched on an endless beach, the sand running to every horizon, his head in his hands
A man bent double under a huge sack, trudging through sand dunes
A lone man in a field as a line of dark storm fronts is drawn up across the horizon against him
A donkey brays with its head thrown back in a bare, dusty field beside an empty feed trough
An ox lies quiet and content beside a manger heaped with hay
A grey-haired man at a kitchen table pushes away a plate of plain egg whites and dry bread
A sick man in bed turns his face away from a tray of pale, bland food
A feverish man in a dark room, a glass of bitter medicine untouched beside him

sections.meaning: Crushed past bearing, he asks God to let loose his hand and end his life while he is still true to the words of the Holy One, for he is not made of stone or bronze and has no strength left to wait.
ideas: In a dark bare room at night a grey-haired man sits on the edge of his bed, bent forward, face lifted and hands open in a plea
An exhausted grey-haired man lies on a bare mattress staring upward, one open hand lifted toward the ceiling
A hand cuts the last thread of a weaving on a loom
A candle burned down to its last flicker in a dark room
In a park a strong bronze statue of a man stands tall on its plinth, and on the bench below it a weary grey-haired man sits slumped and spent
A man leans exhausted against a huge granite boulder, his body sagging while the rock stands unmoved
A rope frayed down to its last strand, still holding a heavy weight
An exhausted runner collapsed at the roadside far from the finish
An old well bucket hauled up empty and dry
Trembling old hands try and fail to lift a cup

sections.meaning: A man losing heart is owed loyalty, but his friends failed him like a desert stream: full and roaring when no one needs it, gone when thirsty travelers come to it, and they drew back from his ruin in fear.
ideas: A mountain stream in early spring roaring full, dark with broken ice, snow heaped on its banks
The same stream bed in high summer, bone-dry, white stones baking in the heat
Thirsty hikers with empty water bottles reach the edge of a dry stream bed and stop in dismay
A broken-down car in the desert beside a dry riverbed, its driver holding an empty water jug
A man alone in a hospital bed, the visitors' chairs empty
Three friends stand back at the edge of the yard of a burnt-out house, hands at their mouths, afraid to come near the man sitting in the ashes
A friend's hand pulling away from a hand that reaches for it
A man holds a cup under the empty spout of a dry fountain
A dry well with an empty bucket
A man at his door watches his friends' cars drive away

sections.meaning: He never asked his friends for money or rescue; he asked only to be shown honestly where he went wrong, not to be lectured and have a despairing man's words brushed aside as wind.
ideas: A weary grey-haired man pushes back an envelope of money his friend holds out, and takes his friend's hand instead
A grey-haired man shakes his head and gently closes his friend's open wallet with his hand
At a kitchen table a friend leans across lecturing with a pointing finger, while a weary grey-haired man sits silent with his hand over his mouth
A grey-haired man holds out an open notebook and a pen to his friend, asking to be shown his mistake
Loose sheets of paper fly away on a strong wind across an empty field
A man calls out on a windy cliff top while his friends stand with their backs turned
Two men shake hands over a deal at a table, ignoring their friend slumped in the corner
A man pours out his heart while his listener looks at his phone
A lost hiker asks a friend to point out on the map where he went off the path
Dandelion seeds blown away by the wind

sections.meaning: Look me in the face: I am not lying to you; turn back, judge me fairly, for my words are honest.
ideas: A close view of a weathered grey-haired man looking straight out of the picture with steady, honest eyes
On a country road a man who had been walking away stops and turns back toward his friend sitting by the roadside
Two men sit facing each other across a small table, looking each other straight in the eye
A man holds up both open hands, palms out, nothing hidden
A man takes off his sunglasses to look someone in the eye
A man tastes a spoonful of soup and knows at once it has gone bad
A friend walking back up the path toward the man's house
A balance scale hanging level
Water so clear the bottom of the pool can be seen
A man standing in bright light at an open door

scenes.principle: If Job's anguish were weighed, it would be heavier than the sand of the seas.
scenes.shows: A grey-haired man sits bowed on one pan of a giant balance scale on a beach; his side has sunk to the sand while the pan heaped with sand is lifted high.
scenes.prompt: On a wide empty beach under a clear sky stands a giant old iron balance scale, taller than a house. On one of its two pans sits a grey-haired man in a plain shirt, bent over with his head in his hands, and his side of the scale has sunk all the way down to the sand. The other pan, piled high with a great mountain of beach sand, is lifted high in the air. The sea stretches away behind.

scenes.principle: No animal cries out while it has its food: his cry comes from real lack, and what he is given sickens him.
scenes.shows: In a bare, sun-baked field a donkey brays with its head thrown back beside an empty feed trough.
scenes.prompt: In a bare, dusty, sun-baked field with no grass at all, a grey donkey stands with its head thrown back and its mouth wide open, braying loudly. Beside it stands an empty wooden feed trough, completely bare. Dry cracked earth stretches away to a pale horizon under a hazy sky.

scenes.principle: Crushed past bearing, he pleads with God to let loose his hand and end his life.
scenes.shows: At night in a dark room a grey-haired man sits on the edge of his bed, face lifted and hands open in a plea.
scenes.prompt: In a dark, bare room at night lit only by one small bedside lamp, a grey-haired man in a plain shirt sits on the edge of his bed, bent forward with exhaustion, his face lifted upward and both hands held open in front of him in a desperate plea. The rest of the room is in deep shadow.

scenes.principle: He has no strength left to wait: his strength is not the strength of stones.
scenes.shows: An exhausted grey-haired man leans his head and whole sagging body against a huge granite boulder.
scenes.prompt: On a bare hillside, a huge grey granite boulder stands solid and unmoved. Against its side an exhausted grey-haired man in a plain shirt leans with his whole body sagging, his head resting on the rock, barely able to stand. Overcast daylight.

scenes.principle: His friends are like a mountain torrent: full and dark with ice and snow in winter, when no one needs it.
scenes.shows: A mountain stream in early spring roars full, dark with broken ice, snow heaped on its banks.
scenes.prompt: A mountain stream in early spring, roaring full and fast between rocky banks, its water dark and churning with broken slabs of ice, deep snow still heaped along both banks and on the boulders. Bare trees and a grey winter sky above.

scenes.principle: Thirsty travelers who hoped in that stream come to it and find it dry, and are put to shame: so his friends failed him.
scenes.shows: Tired hikers in hot desert hills reach a stream bed and find it bone-dry; the leader holds up an empty water bottle.
scenes.prompt: In hot, dry desert hills under a blazing sky, a small line of tired, sunburnt hikers carrying backpacks has just reached the edge of a wide stream bed, and they stop in dismay: the channel is completely dry, nothing but bleached white stones and cracked mud. The one in front holds up an empty water bottle, and the others' faces fall.

scenes.principle: He never asked them for money or rescue, only for their faithfulness.
scenes.shows: A weary grey-haired man pushes back an envelope of money his friend holds out, and takes his friend's hand instead.
scenes.prompt: In a plain living room, a well-dressed man holds out a thick envelope of money to his weary grey-haired friend. The grey-haired man gently pushes the envelope back with one hand, shaking his head, and with his other hand takes hold of his friend's hand instead. Soft daylight from a window.

scenes.principle: Teach me and I will be silent: show me my real wrong instead of lecturing a despairing man.
scenes.shows: At a kitchen table a man leans across lecturing with a pointing finger while a weary grey-haired man sits silent, his hand over his mouth.
scenes.prompt: At a plain kitchen table, a man in a neat shirt leans across the table lecturing, jabbing his pointing finger at the weary grey-haired man opposite him. The grey-haired man sits silent and listening, one hand pressed over his mouth, his eyes tired and searching. Plain daylight from a window.

scenes.principle: Look me in the face: I will not lie to you; turn back and judge fairly.
scenes.shows: A weathered grey-haired man looks straight out of the picture with steady, honest eyes.
scenes.prompt: A close portrait of a weathered grey-haired man in a plain shirt, worn by grief, looking straight out of the picture into the viewer's eyes, steady, open and honest, nothing hidden in his face. Soft, clear daylight on his face, a plain softly blurred room behind him.
